textbookBox.concept: Every day we use things like books, pencils and toys, and some of them help us work. Have you ever wondered how they work, and how they could work even better? Meera and Dhruv love finding out.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 4 evs · How Things Work · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: Take aluminium foil and see what happens when its shape changes. When the foil is spread out, or made into a cup shape, it floats. When the foil is pressed tightly into a ball, it sinks.
